about_the_game:
■ABOUT THIS CONTENT 

I thought it was just the same old routine as always... 

-A story of you and him, recollections of your life and love, as the seasons change... 

You can read side stories about each of lovers of “Re : promise ～Promise of Linalia～” 

A sweet and precious moment that brings you and Shiki closer together. 

Enjoy a new side of Shiki not depicted in the main story, accompanied by a still illustration and a voice-over scenario available only here. 

A side story perfect for those who want to immerse themselves even more in the main story after reading it. 

  

※ Unlocked after reading a certain chapter in the main story.

content_descriptors.notes: Some stories may contain scenes of a sexual nature not suitable for all ages.
